priority_application.reproducibility: ASR Transformers checkpoints precede additional NeMo environment; SpeechBrain chosen for well-documented native speech-LID API.
priority_application.diversity: ASR: CTC + medium/full large Whisper. LID: native ECAPA + MMS raw-waveform classifier + medium Whisper. Text: base XLNet + large RoBERTa + BART classifier.
priority_application.proximity: All new local gamma/mu UNKNOWN; neither claimed near-target nor rejected based on guessed slowness.
priority_application.reported_quality: large-v3 generation improvement selects the full-large representative; all shortlisted Text checkpoints have published same-task evidence. Cross-dataset values are not directly ordered.
priority_application.deterministic_ID: Fixed exact IDs/revisions and lexicographic measurement order; no post-measurement replacement.
